chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhassin ibn Ahmad from Aban from Umar ibn Yazeed who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'A man is bequeathed a Hajj, but it does not suffice for it.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'So he should proceed with it until he performs Hajj before the time [is due/ends].'

key_terms.حَجَّةٍ: A specific year of Hajj or the responsibility of performing Hajj
key_terms.فَلَمْ تَكْفِهِ: Did not suffice / was not enough
key_terms.فَيُقَدِّمُهَا: So he should proceed/advance with it

ai.seo_question: What should one do if the money left for Hajj is not enough to cover the full cost?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the procedure for a *Hajj al-Istibdal* agent whose stipend is insufficient, ruling that they should proceed with the pilgrimage using available funds rather than delaying. This highlights the Shia juristic principle of prioritizing the completion of the obligatory Hajj over waiting for full payment, ensuring the religious duty is fulfilled even if it means performing it 'before the time' (i.e., with limited resources). The ruling underscores the practical flexibility in Hajj jurisprudence to prevent the neglect of the duty due to financial constraints.
